//: Copy to arch.config.json to point the arch-graph at your local consuming apps. Consumer paths are relative to the MAIN checkout (not a worktree), so `../voltras` means a sibling of titan-design either way. kind 'native' scans react-native primitive imports; 'web' consumers use RNW/HTML. Missing paths are skipped (in-library-only analysis).
//codewatchCli: Absolute path to a built @codewatch/cli entry (packages/cli/dist/index.js in a codewatch checkout). Only needed when your checkout is not a sibling of titan-design — the script finds ../codewatch on its own. @codewatch/cli is unpublished (AW-118), so npx cannot supply it.
